content.chapeau: The term “digital infrastructure” means any system, network, or facility that—
processes, stores, or transmits data in digital form, including—

subparagraph.text: is designated as critical infrastructure under section 5195c of title 42.

paragraph.text: The term “covered entity” means any person who owns, operates, or maintains digital infrastructure serving more than 100,000 users.

content.chapeau: The term “critical vulnerability” means a security flaw that—

subparagraph.text: allows unauthorized access to protected systems;
enables the exfiltration of personally identifiable information; or
could result in the disruption of essential services as defined in section 103 of this title.

subsection.heading: Rules of construction
subsection.text: Nothing in this chapter shall be construed to limit the authority of the Secretary under section 652 of title 6.

subsection.heading: In general
subsection.text: Each covered entity (as defined in section 101 of this title) shall submit to the Director an annual report containing the information described in subsection (b).

content.chapeau: Each report submitted under subsection (a) shall include—

paragraph.text: a description of the digital infrastructure operated by the covered entity;

subparagraph.text: any critical vulnerability (as defined in section 101) discovered during the reporting period; and
remediation actions taken with respect to each such vulnerability; and

paragraph.text: certification of compliance with applicable standards under section 7431 of title 15.

subsection.heading: Deadline
subsection.text: The report required under subsection (a) shall be submitted not later than 90 days after the end of each fiscal year.

subsection.heading: Civil penalties
subsection.text: Any covered entity that fails to comply with section 102 of this title shall be subject to a civil penalty of not more than $500,000 for each violation.

subsection.heading: Criminal penalties
subsection.text: Any person who knowingly and willfully violates section 102 with intent to conceal a critical vulnerability shall be fined under section 3571 of title 18, imprisoned not more than 5 years, or both.

note.heading: Effective Date
note.text: Pub. L. 118–200, title I, §104, Mar. 15, 2024, 138 Stat. 1006, provided that: “This title [enacting this chapter] shall take effect on the date that is 180 days after the date of enactment of this Act [Mar. 15, 2024].”

note.heading: Repeal
note.text: Pub. L. 119–5, §7, Jan. 10, 2025, 139 Stat. 45, repealed this section, which related to authorization of appropriations for fiscal years 2025 through 2029.

section.heading: Authorization of appropriations
section.text: There are authorized to be appropriated to carry out this chapter $50,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2025 through 2029.
